en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a stone fountain built against a brick wall. The fountain features a large sculpted swan with spread wings; water flows from its beak into a basin below. Above the bird is a decorative heraldic plaque with the word "SIEGE" and the date "1854". The scene is on a cobbled street with a few pedestrians and trees in the background. Printed titles identify the place and publisher.
